translations.literal: Fan Tingzhao was a native of Zaoqiang in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Tingzhao was a native of Zaoqiang in Jizhou.

translations.zh: 父鐸，為里中惡少年所害。
translations.literal: His father Duo was killed by vicious youths in the village.
translations.idiomatic: His father Duo was killed by vicious youths in the village.

translations.zh: 廷召年十八，手刃父仇，剖取其心以祭父墓。
translations.literal: At eighteen Tingzhao personally killed his father's murderer, cut out his heart, and offered it in sacrifice at his father's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen Tingzhao personally killed his father's murderer, cut out his heart, and offered it in sacrifice at his father's tomb.

translations.zh: 弱冠，身長七尺餘，有膂力。
translations.literal: Upon reaching manhood he stood more than seven chi in height and possessed great physical strength.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching manhood he stood more than seven chi in height and possessed great physical strength.

translations.literal: He had once been a bandit and was known for courage and strength.
translations.idiomatic: He had once been a bandit and was known for courage and strength.

translations.zh: 周廣順初，應募為北面招收指揮使。
translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangshun in Zhou he answered the call for recruits and became commander of the Northern Recruitment Guard.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Guangshun in Zhou he answered the call for recruits and became commander of the Northern Recruitment Guard.

translations.literal: When Shizong ascended the throne, he entered service as a palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong ascended the throne, he entered service as a palace guard.

translations.zh: 從征高平，戰疾力，遷殿前指揮使。
translations.literal: He followed the campaign at Gaoping, fought with fierce exertion, and was promoted to commander of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign at Gaoping, fought with fierce exertion, and was promoted to commander of the Palace Guard.

translations.zh: 從征淮南，戰紫金山，流矢中左股。
translations.literal: He followed the Huainan campaign, fought at Purple Gold Mountain, and was struck in the left thigh by a stray arrow.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the Huainan campaign, fought at Purple Gold Mountain, and was struck in the left thigh by a stray arrow.
